about: Lexapro (escitalopram) 20 mg tablets, named by brand only, are supplied every four weeks with the direction ONE tablet in the morning to a patient aged 71, which is 20 mg a day and above the 10 mg limit.

Celapram (citalopram) is supplied at 20 mg a day before and after, but four supplies from January to April 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history, are 40 mg tablets taken ONE a day by a patient aged 68, which is above the 20 mg limit.
Cipramil (citalopram) 20 mg tablets are supplied every four weeks with the direction ONE tablet in the morning to a patient aged 73, which is 20 mg a day: equal to the limit, not above it.
